notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Added a cursor which indicates whether a tile can be picked up, placed, is blocked, or out of sight.
Added color highlight when hovering over a menu button.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changed level 35 to make the solution more clear.
Added an notice to hints in the pause menu.
Fixed a visual bug when trying to picking up a floor while standing on it.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Players can rewind after death after being crushed or shot by a laser.
Rebinded restarting the level to R and rewinding to Z
